June 6, 2018 - By Ellis Scott
Evermay Wealth Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 9.94% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Evermay Wealth Management Llc sold 2,849 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 25,800 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $4.33 million, down from 28,649 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Evermay Wealth Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $950.15 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.77% or $1.48 during the last trading session, reaching $193.31. About 19.54M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 6, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
